_doc: DRAFT v2 for the user's approval (production/plans/combat-formations.md; written by tools/design/author_diagram_draft_v2.py). As the engine's diagram record (design/gdd/formations.md rule 1) plus: node unlock (the diagram level that opens it), link bend (drawing only), figure (decorative strokes behind the nodes). Values at strength 1; positive and gate nodes and feeds scale with S, negative ones do not.

diagrams.name: Long Serpent Line
diagrams.idea: A line that grows a node with each level (2, 3, 4): the tail drives the body, the body drives the head.

diagrams.name: Two Poles
diagrams.taught_by: Daoist and righteous sects, outer disciple
diagrams.idea: Only two nodes, each feeding the other: yang strikes, yin pays. One level: it is complete as taught.

diagrams.name: Three Talents
diagrams.taught_by: sects of any path, outer disciple
diagrams.idea: Heaven, Earth and Man around a circle; at level 3 the centre opens and all three feed it.

diagrams.name: Turtle Shell
diagrams.idea: Plates of a shell around the wards: cheaper wards, faster beside them, a held heal for when it cracks. All four plates from the start; levels only harden them.

diagrams.name: Four Symbols
diagrams.idea: All four beasts from the start, joined around the ring; at level 3 the crossing opens: Dragon feeds Tiger and Bird feeds Tortoise across the centre.

diagrams.name: Five Phases
diagrams.idea: All five elements around the circle, each feeding the one it creates; at level 4 the star of overcoming lights up and each element also feeds the one it overcomes.

diagrams.name: Sun and Moons
diagrams.idea: A heavy art at the sun with one moon in orbit; a second moon rises at level 3 and a third at level 5. Each moon pays a price and feeds the sun.

diagrams.name: Back to the River
diagrams.taught_by: a loose cultivators' manual (a later drop); sects of any path, inner disciple
diagrams.idea: With your back to the river: a held art for below half health, a strong art beside it, and a costly feeder that drives the held one. One level: a desperate trick, never refined.

diagrams.name: Soul Maze
diagrams.taught_by: demonic and curse sects, inner disciple
diagrams.idea: Curses spiral inward toward a centre that fires only after 10 s, when the maze has closed. Four nodes always; three levels.

diagrams.name: Twin Dragons and the Pearl
diagrams.idea: Two dragons coil toward a pearl and their heads feed its heavy art; at level 4 both dragons grow their bodies at once, each feeding its head.

diagrams.name: Seven Stars of the Northern Dipper
diagrams.idea: The four bowl stars from the start, each quicker beside a sword art; at level 3 the whole handle appears at once, feeding toward Dao Quang, the sword star at its end (seven nodes: Hóa Thần, or a bonus art slot).

diagrams.name: Eight Trigrams
diagrams.idea: The four cardinal trigrams from the start, opposite pairs feeding across the taiji; at level 4 the four between them open together, joined in a ring (eight nodes: Hóa Thần with a bonus art slot).

diagrams.name: Three Flowers at the Crown
diagrams.idea: Three petals around a crown: each petal's art is cheaper, and all three feed the crown when it opens at level 2.

diagrams.name: Wind and Fire Wheels
diagrams.idea: Two wheels side by side: the wind wheel spins the fire wheel faster, the fire wheel burns hotter. Two levels.

diagrams.name: Clear Breeze Sword
diagrams.idea: Along a blade: hilt, edge and point. The point opens at level 4 and the edge feeds it.

diagrams.name: Spring Return
diagrams.taught_by: healing and alchemist sects, outer disciple
diagrams.idea: A sprouting branch for healers: cheaper heals, and a heal that waits until you are below 70 % health.

diagrams.name: Thunderclap
diagrams.idea: Two nodes and a bolt: the striker charges the finisher, which waits until the foe is below 30 % health. One level.

diagrams.name: Earth Wall
diagrams.taught_by: earth and body sects, outer disciple
diagrams.idea: Three peaks of a wall: cheaper bulwark and ward arts, and earth arts quicker beside them.

diagrams.name: Four Gates
diagrams.idea: A square courtyard with a gate on each side: two gates open at first, the third at level 2, the last at level 4; each gate quickens the next.

diagrams.name: Water Curtain
diagrams.idea: Four drops along a falling curtain, water arts each; at level 3 the curtain closes and the drops feed each other down it.

diagrams.name: Fire Dragon Coil
diagrams.idea: A fire dragon coils inward to its head; a fourth coil opens at level 4. The tail pays the price.

diagrams.name: Ice Seal
diagrams.idea: A six-pointed ice crystal: cold arts beside each other run quicker; its control node holds until the foe carries two statuses.

diagrams.name: Immortal-Binding Net
diagrams.idea: A net of four knots: seal arts bind quicker beside control arts, and the net's last knot holds a curse until the foe is cursed twice.

diagrams.name: Black Fiend Wind
diagrams.idea: A cold wind of poisons: two costly nodes drive the poison and curse arts hard. Strong and expensive.

diagrams.name: Golden Bell Cover
diagrams.taught_by: body-cultivation and Buddhist sects, inner disciple
diagrams.idea: A bell over the body: body arts and bells cheaper, and a struck bell rings back while your body shield holds.

diagrams.name: Lotus Throne
diagrams.taught_by: Buddhist and healing sects, inner disciple
diagrams.idea: A seat with two petals; at level 3 two more petals open together. The petals carry the seat's heals and wards.

diagrams.name: Seven-String Zither
diagrams.idea: Strings of a zither: song arts beside each other play quicker; the third string waits for the fifth pulse of every cycle.

diagrams.name: Army-Breaker Wedge
diagrams.taught_by: spear and military sects, inner disciple
diagrams.idea: A spearhead wedge: the point and two shoulders from the start; at level 4 both flanks open together and drive the shoulders.

diagrams.name: Moon Shadow
diagrams.taught_by: assassin and wind sects, inner disciple
diagrams.idea: On a crescent: quick arts strike first and fastest, and the shadow's blow only lands in the first 8 s. Two levels.

diagrams.name: Myriad Swords Return
diagrams.idea: A fan of blades converging on one: four sword nodes feed the centre's heavy sword art. No growth, only strength.

diagrams.name: Nine Palaces
diagrams.idea: The magic square: the centre cross of five from the start; two corners at level 3, the other two at level 5 (nine nodes: only with bonus art slots). Corners quicken the arts beside them.

diagrams.name: Heaven's Net, Earth's Snare
diagrams.idea: Above, a net of control; below, a snare of seals. The snare's jaw closes only on a foe below half health.

diagrams.name: Sea of Blood
diagrams.idea: A red tide that rises with your wounds: two nodes strike only once you have lost half your health, a third pays the tide's price.

diagrams.name: River of Stars
diagrams.idea: Five stars along the galaxy's curve, each feeding the next downstream; at level 5 the river closes into a loop.

diagrams.name: Wind and Thunder
diagrams.taught_by: lightning and wind sects, core disciple
diagrams.idea: Two wind nodes and two thunder nodes in alternation; wind feeds thunder, thunder feeds wind, and the eye of the storm opens at level 4.

diagrams.name: Vajra Demon-Subduing
diagrams.idea: The vajra's two prongs and its grip: wards and bulwarks cheap at the grip, the prongs strike hardest while your body shield holds.

diagrams.name: Night Parade of a Hundred Ghosts
diagrams.idea: A procession of summons under lanterns; two more ghosts join the end of the line at level 5. Each ghost hastens the one ahead.

diagrams.name: Poison Dragon Drill
diagrams.idea: A drill that bores into a cursed foe: its tip strikes only once the foe carries three curses; the threads feed the tip.

diagrams.name: Kun Becomes Peng
diagrams.idea: Fish below, bird above: the fish half pays and feeds the bird half, which strikes only while your linh lực is above 60 %.

diagrams.name: Six Harmonies
diagrams.idea: Two triangles of a hexagram: the upward one quickens, the downward one strikes; each point is beside its two neighbours of the other triangle.

diagrams.name: Ten Directions Annihilation
diagrams.idea: A burst of ten rays from one heart: six nodes on the rays all feed the heart's art, which strikes only after you have not been hit for 3 s.

diagrams.name: Taiji Returns to Wuji
diagrams.taught_by: a Daoist immortal's stele (a special encounter)
diagrams.idea: Concentric emptiness: one centre, and two rings that pour into it. One level: perfect as found, never raised.

diagrams.name: Myriad Beasts Pay Homage
diagrams.idea: Summons gather toward the throne: three beasts from the start, a fourth at level 2, a fifth at level 5; every beast beside a summon art strikes harder.

diagrams.name: Strange Gates Hidden Stems
diagrams.idea: Eight doors around a hidden centre; the doors that open change with the pulse (open on every second pulse), and the centre steals linh lực back.

diagrams.name: Furnace of Heaven and Earth
diagrams.idea: A cauldron on three legs: the fire below feeds the vessel, and whatever burns in it gains more the more elements burn on you.

diagrams.name: Great Celestial Star Wheel
diagrams.name_vi: Chu Thiên Tinh Đấu Đại Trận
diagrams.taught_by: the highest formation-master sect's founder's hall
diagrams.idea: Seven stars on three orbits around the pole star: the inner orbit feeds the pole, the outer orbits feed the inner; the third orbit opens at level 3.

diagrams.name: Four Heavenly Swords
diagrams.idea: Four great swords planted at the four gates, each feeding the next around the ring; at level 4 the centre awakens and every sword feeds it.

diagrams.name: Primordial Chaos
diagrams.idea: No fixed shape: chaos arts swirl through five uneven nodes, quickening each other in a loop, while two nodes pay the price of holding chaos together.

diagrams.name: Wheel of Rebirth
diagrams.taught_by: a reincarnated cultivator's teaching (a special character)
diagrams.idea: Six paths around a wheel, each feeding the next; the hub's art turns only when you are near death, once below 25 % health.

diagrams.name: Myriad Phenomena Return to One
diagrams.taught_by: a sect-founder's final manuscript (a rare drop)
diagrams.idea: Many arts, one strike: six outer nodes all feed a single centre, each costing more. Two levels only, but the second adds the seventh.
